request.style: English, Solo male voice, warm and resonant, solo with choir, acoustic guitar, fiddle, bodhran, celtic harp, mood is solemn and historical, tempo 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Rooted deep in the soil of Judah
The branch of Jerahmeel grew
Hezron's firstborn led the way
Ram and Bunah in their day
Oren and Ozem stood beside
Ahijah walking with pride
Another wife named Atarah
Mother of Onam in the earth

[Verse]
Shammai and Jada were born
From Onam's line in the dawn
Shammai's sons were Nadab and Abishur
Abishur's wife bore the fruit
Abihail gave birth to Ahban
Molid joined in the clan
Nadab's sons were Seled and Appaim
Seled died without children's claim

[Chorus]
But Appaim carried the name
Sole heir in the house of fame
The son of Appaim was Ishi
Who walked in the faithful day
Sheshan came after Ishi
And Ahlai closed the way
The genealogy stands and tells
Of the tribe that never falls

[Verse]
The sons of Sheshan followed on
Ahlai kept the tradition
Recording names for inheritance
Tribal rights in the land
From Judah down through Jerahmeel
The lines were kept whole and real
No brother's line was lost in the dark
For Appaim left his mark

[Chorus]
But Appaim carried the name
Sole heir in the house of fame
The son of Appaim was Ishi
Who walked in the faithful day
Sheshan came after Ishi
And Ahlai closed the way
The genealogy stands and tells
Of the tribe that never falls

[Outro]
Son of Appaim, Ishi
The line continues on
Sheshan, Ahlai, the end
Of the chronicle's song
